newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 surges through 600 barrier to 2-yr high.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 surges through 600 barrier to 2-yr high.

text.p: The Czech PX50 broke through the 600 point barrier to a two-year high on Wednesday driven mainly by foreign buying of blue chip issues, analysts said.
The PX50 gained 0.65 percent to 603 while the major issue dominated RPIX index of continuously traded shares rose 0.9 percent to 1,284.2.

The PX50 index was boosted by investors continuing to turn their attention away from other central European markets, analysts said, in favour of the Czech bourse which significantly underperformed its neighbours in 1996.
"Hungary, for example, is already overheated and investors there are taking profits and preferring to buy Czech shares," Miroslav Nosal of Patria Finance told Reuters.
In 1996 the PX50 index rose 27 percent compared with well over 100 percent on the Hungarian BUX index and around 90 percent on the Polish WIG index.
The top four most heavily weighted Czech major issues, which account for more than half of the index's total captalisation, all rose.

Komercni Banka led the way with a 1.9 percent rise to 2,685, power utility CEZ rose 1.88 percent, to 1,245, SPT Telecom gained 0.5 percent to 3,760 and savings bank Ceska Sporitelna rose 1.87 percent to 327.

"It seems to me that all the stocks that are 'investible' for portfolio investors are rising now...This indicates that foreign investors are behind the increase," said Pavel Sobisek of Zivnostenska Banka.

The above four issues pushed the PX50 to its highest level for more than two years, but analysts said that such technical factors did not play a great role in the Czech market and urged that investors concentrate on fundamentals.
"Today is a famous day because of that (crossing the 600 mark). But on the other hand I don't think that technical analysis in our market has such a big influence," said Sobisek.
"I don't think that by breaking through this level the market would get another boost," he added.
